name: nat_mul_mono
goal: ∀ (w x y z : Nat), w ≤ x → y ≤ z → w * y ≤ x * z

name: nat_square_injective
goal: ∀ (x y : Nat), x * x = y * y → x = y

name: nat_square_injective_named
definitions:
def square (x : Nat) : Nat := x * x
def isInjective (f : Nat → Nat) : Prop := ∀ x y, f x = f y → x = y

name: nat_distributive
goal: ∀ (x y z : Nat), (x + y) * z = x * z + y * z

name: nat_succ_exists
goal: ∀ (x : Nat), x ≠ 0 → ∃ (y : Nat), x = Nat.succ y

name: nat_mod_lt
goal: ∀ (x y : Nat), y > 0 → x % y < y

name: nat_mod_add_mul
goal: ∀ (x y z : Nat), (x + y * z) % y = x % y

name: nat_mod_mul_factor
goal: ∀ (x y z : Nat), (z * x) % (z * y) = z * (x % y)

name: poly_option
goal: ∀ (α : Type) (x : Option α), x.isSome = true → x ≠ none

name: string_assoc
goal: ∀ (s t u : String), (s ++ t) ++ u = s ++ (t ++ u)
